digest: finding-002 KEEP: isWorkflowStopRequestedError also matches a message prefix, which violates the name-only rule in S6; no test covers it.

evidence.relevance: Implementation also classifies errors by message prefix, not only by name

finalClaim: isWorkflowStopRequestedError (src/workflow-stop.ts:53-59) returns true for any Error whose message starts with 'workflow stop requested', contrary to S6's name-only rule. No test exercises this path, and no src caller depends on it.
recommendedAction: Drop the message-prefix clause so the check is name-only, and add a unit test that a plain Error with a stop-prefixed message returns false.
